recommendation: R-ld02-1 A: use measured LLD-compatible lazy discovery; implemented recommendation, not a ruling
semantics: Archive-index entries become lazy in index order; a strong unresolved reference extracts immediately and recursively. Earlier archives remain available, matching LLD's backward-reference control. Weak references do not pull. Cycles select each member once.
cost_caveat: The before/after link inputs have equal identity, order, size and hash. Total times include retained-relocation/full-provenance changes and different host load, so no extraction-only whole-link speedup is claimed; resolver delta isolates extraction.
